map.巡检路线与周期计划 使用指南: Inspection Route and Cycle Planner User Guide
map.建立巡检路线与检查点，按周期自动排程，记录完成情况并统计完成率与问题数。: Build inspection routes and checkpoints, schedule them automatically by cycle, record completion and tally completion rate and issue counts.
map.物业工程或安保按路线规划每日巡检点与频次: Property engineering or security plans daily inspection points and frequency by route
map.系统算下次到期日并提醒，防漏检: The system computes the next due date and reminds, preventing missed inspections
map.节假日加密重点区域（配电、消防）巡检: Increase inspections in key areas (distribution, fire protection) during holidays
map.：某路线频次 7 天、上次巡检 2026-03-10 → 下次到期 2026-0: : a route on a 7-day cycle last inspected 2026-03-10 → next due 2026-03-17; on 03-19 it is 2 days overdue, flagged red for make-up inspection.
map.：A 路线含配电房 + 水泵房 + 消防栓（每日）、B 路线含楼道 + 车库（每: : route A covers the distribution room + pump room + hydrants (daily), route B covers corridors + garage (every 3 days) → resourcing: 1 person/day for A, rotating duty for B.
map.巡检周期怎么定？: How is the inspection cycle set?
map.按风险：配电、消防每日，一般公区每周；法规或合同有要求的从其规定。: By risk: distribution and fire protection daily, general common areas weekly; follow regulation or contract where they specify.
map.漏检了怎么补？: How do I make up a missed inspection?
map.系统标红逾期项，主管安排补检并登记原因，避免因漏检导致设备隐患扩大。: The system marks overdue items in red so supervisors can arrange make-up inspections and log the reason, preventing equipment hazards from growing after a missed check.
